high_level_description: Sparse 1600x900 landscape SVG draft showing six precise physical interactions: woman adjusting hose near bicycle/fence (left), terrier digging at oak base, cat on pickup hood, red-and-black ladybug chain linking oak branch to tennis ball (right), and drone overhead — all on plain light-gray background.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Plain light-gray (#f0f0f0) canvas with no texture or detail

elements.desc: Purple bent female figure (L-shaped polygon), left side, adjusting hose nozzle with right arm extended downward
Curved blue water arc (cubic Bézier stroke) originating from hose nozzle near woman's hand, sweeping rightward
Black simplified bicycle silhouette leaning rightward, touching short fence
Short brown fence segment (3 vertical bars + horizontal cap), aligned vertically, touched by bicycle rear wheel
Brown terrier dog digging — compact oval body with four short downward leg lines, positioned at base of oak trunk
Oak trunk base — wide brown rectangle with three vertical groove lines, ground-level anchor for terrier and ladybug chain start
Orange seated cat with triangular ears, paws resting on gray pickup truck hood surface
Gray trapezoidal pickup truck hood, tilted slightly upward, supporting cat
Red-and-black ladybug chain — 9 alternating solid circles (red/black) following smooth curve from low oak branch endpoint to tennis ball center
Thin brown horizontal oak branch segment, origin point of ladybug chain
Red tennis ball with small white highlight circle, target endpoint of ladybug chain
Black drone icon — central dot with four equal-length arms (X shape), hovering above scene center
